decisions.reason: A schlager compilation CD draws directly on the firm's long-standing knowledge of compiling and reissuing overlooked recordings, so it fits its absorptive base and supports the stated move into wider genres, even though schlager sits somewhat outside its non-mainstream core.
An illustrated release series builds on the label's core skill of carefully produced, curated editions for collectors, so the firm can read early sales and refine new releases in the line.
